observed_failure: The external 30-second process cap killed two C0 cases before run_r2 returned, leaving calls=None and making preregistered per-case call parity unobservable.
allowed_change: Wrap the preserved runner call_one function with a non-semantic append-only CALL_BEGIN audit counter in each isolated case process. The wrapper delegates immediately to the original call_one and does not alter arguments, return values, exception handling, retry policy, composition, fail seed, subset, or 30-second cap.
timeout_measurement: For a killed process, tool_calls is the number of durable CALL_BEGIN audit records. For a normally completed process, audited call count must equal len(traces); mismatch invalidates the run.
restart_rule: Discard the partial parent execution as confirmatory evidence and restart C0 and C1 from case 1 on the unchanged frozen 40-case subset.
parity_rule: For every case, C0 and C1 audited tool-call counts must be identical, including timeout cases. Timeout status must also match; otherwise execution parity FAILS.
oracle_policy: Remain closed until both repaired arms are fully frozen.
